A2AGENT_API_KEY.description: A2Agent API key — Qwen, DeepSeek and MiniMax via the A2Agent gateway (Chinese model vendors)

ANDROID_APP_URL.description: Play Store link shown on the forced-update screen (Android).

APPLE_CLIENT_ID.description: Apple Services ID (web OAuth client ID / id_token audience)

APPLE_KEY_ID.description: Key ID of the Sign-in-with-Apple private key (.p8)

APP_ADMIN_EMAIL.description: Operator inbox for incident + content-moderation alerts

BRAND_ACCENT_COLOR.description: Optional accent color as a hex value. Leave empty to keep the default palette.

BRAND_ACCENT_COLOR_DARK.description: Optional accent color used in DARK mode as a hex value. Leave empty to reuse the light accent color.

BRAND_DEFAULT_ROUTE.description: Post-login default: a route name (e.g. "chat") or a free-form path starting with "/" (e.g. "/files"). Leave empty to keep the default; unknown values fail safe to the default.

BRAND_FONT_FAMILY.description: Body font-family CSS stack (e.g. "Inter, sans-serif"). Leave empty to keep the default font.

BRAND_FONT_URL.description: Optional web-font stylesheet URL (self-hosted or provider). The origin must be on the CSP allow-list; for the app, on the configured server's allowed origins. Leave empty for no external font.

BRAND_HEADING_FONT_FAMILY.description: Optional heading font-family CSS stack. Leave empty to fall back to the body font/default.

BRAND_HOMEPAGE_URL.description: Brand homepage link used on auth and footer surfaces.

BRAND_ICON_URL.description: Brand icon URL (SVG recommended). Used for the sidebar mark, the favicon and the faint background watermark. Empty falls back to the light logo, then to the bundled Synaplan bird.

BRAND_LANDING_PAGE.description: Logged-out landing: a route name (e.g. "login") or a free-form path starting with "/" (e.g. "/welcome"). Must be a public page. Leave empty to keep the default; unknown/non-public values fail safe to the default.

BRAND_LOGO_DARK_URL.description: Dark-mode logo URL. Leave empty to use the bundled Synaplan logo.

BRAND_LOGO_URL.description: Light-mode logo URL. Leave empty to use the bundled Synaplan logo.

BRAND_NAME.description: Displayed brand/product name (document title, auth screens, attribution).

BRAND_POWERED_BY_LABEL.description: Attribution label — the platform being credited (e.g. "Synaplan").

BRAND_POWERED_BY_URL.description: Attribution link target for the "powered by" label.

BRAND_PRIMARY_COLOR.description: Primary accent color as a hex value (e.g. #003fc7). Injected into the --brand CSS variables at runtime.

BRAND_PRIMARY_COLOR_DARK.description: Primary accent color used in DARK mode as a hex value. Leave empty to auto-derive a dark-friendly tint from the light primary color.

BRAND_PRIVACY_URL.description: Privacy-policy link. Reachable in-app (Settings) and used in store metadata; store policy (Apple/Google) requires it. White-label brands point this at their own page.

BRAND_SECONDARY_COLOR.description: Optional secondary color as a hex value. Leave empty to keep the default palette.

BRAND_SECONDARY_COLOR_DARK.description: Optional secondary color used in DARK mode as a hex value. Leave empty to reuse the light secondary color.

BRAND_SHOW_POWERED_BY.description: Show the "· powered by <label>" attribution across auth, logged-out, shared-chat and widget surfaces.

BRAND_TAGLINE.description: Optional short tagline/description shown beside the brand.

BRAND_TERMS_URL.description: Terms-of-use link. Reachable in-app (Settings) and used in store metadata. White-label brands point this at their own page.

CEREBRAS_API_KEY.description: Cerebras Inference API key — GPT OSS 120B and Qwen 3.8 27B. Create it at https://cloud.cerebras.ai/ (API Keys)

CHAT_ARTIFACTS_ENABLED.description: Offer a sandboxed preview for HTML and SVG answers. Off when this row is missing and CHAT_ARTIFACTS_ENABLED is empty. An explicit on in either place turns the preview on. An explicit off in either place turns it off.

CHAT_EXPORT_ENABLED.description: Let people download a chat (Markdown, PDF, JSON) and include chats in account export. A group policy can turn this off for one group. On when this row is missing.

CHAT_SHARE_ENABLED.description: Let people create a public link for a chat. A group policy can turn this off for one group. On when this row is missing.

CHAT_WELCOME_SHOW_STORE_CARDS.description: Show the App Store, Google Play and GitHub cards on an empty chat. On when this row is missing, so existing installations stay as they are until you turn it off.

CHAT_WELCOME_SHOW_WIDGET_PROMO.description: Show the "embed a chat widget on your website" promotion above the composer. On when this row is missing.

CLOUDFLARE_ACCOUNT_ID.description: Cloudflare account ID for Workers AI embeddings (bge-m3)

CLOUDFLARE_API_TOKEN.description: Cloudflare API token with Workers AI access

COMPUTE_DEFAULT_CPU.description: Default CPU share for a file-work run.

COMPUTE_DEFAULT_MEMORY_MB.description: Default memory cap in megabytes for a file-work run.

COMPUTE_DEFAULT_OUTPUT_MB.description: Default size cap in megabytes for files the run may create.

COMPUTE_DEFAULT_PIDS.description: Default process cap for a file-work run.

COMPUTE_DEFAULT_TIMEOUT_SEC.description: Default seconds a file-work run may take.

COMPUTE_EGRESS_ENABLED.description: Let a file-work run fetch from a short list of public websites the assistant named. Off by default — runs stay offline. Private or local addresses are always refused. Can only be switched on when the connected compute sidecar offers website access (features.egress in its health report).

COMPUTE_EGRESS_MAX_HOSTS.description: How many websites one file-work run may list. Default 8.

COMPUTE_EGRESS_REQUIRES_APPROVAL.description: When a run will fetch from the web, ask the owner first even if everyday file work would run automatically. On by default.

COMPUTE_ENABLED.description: Let the assistant do short file work (Python or Node) on copies of files you chose. Needs the compute sidecar (COMPUTE_URL + COMPUTE_TOKEN). Local `docker compose up` starts that sidecar and turns this on.

COMPUTE_MAX_TIMEOUT_SEC.description: Hard ceiling in seconds for a file-work run.

COMPUTE_POLICY_INTERACTIVE.description: When the owner is present (chat or a live API call): run file work automatically, ask first, or never run it. An assistant cannot loosen this.

COMPUTE_POLICY_UNATTENDED.description: When a saved task runs file work on its own: ask the owner first (default), run automatically, or never run it. An assistant cannot loosen this.

COMPUTE_REQUIRE_TIER.description: Minimum isolation the compute sidecar must report before file work turns on: Standard (plain Docker), Strong isolation (gVisor), Virtual machine (microVM). Synaplan Cloud requires Strong isolation.

COMPUTE_WORKSPACES_ENABLED.description: Keep a folder between file-work runs so the assistant can continue yesterday's work. Off by default. Files → Workspace shows what is in it. Also needs file work itself to be on.

COMPUTE_WORKSPACE_TTL_DAYS.description: How many days a file-work folder may sit unused before cleanup can remove it. Default 90.

CONVERSATION_SUMMARY_CACHE_TTL.description: Seconds the stored summary is kept before Redis expires it. The summary is refreshed asynchronously after each long-chat turn, so a follow-up turn never waits on the summarizer. Raise this on quiet installs; lower it only if you need settings changes to take effect faster.

CONVERSATION_SUMMARY_ENABLED.description: Condense the earlier part of a long chat into a rolling summary that is injected into the system prompt, while the newest turns are still replayed word for word. Keeps the topic, the user's position and past decisions alive many answers later. The summary is written asynchronously after each turn by the Summary model (configurable under AI → Routing), so answering stays snappy. When OFF, a long chat only ever sees the most recent turns.

CONVERSATION_SUMMARY_MAX_CHARS.description: Hard cap on the injected summary itself. Capped at whatever the window has left after the verbatim turns.

CONVERSATION_SUMMARY_MAX_SOURCE_MESSAGES.description: Upper bound on how many older messages are fed to the Summary model in one call. Bounds the cost of summarizing a very long conversation; older messages beyond this are represented by the previous summary.

CONVERSATION_SUMMARY_RECENT_VERBATIM_CHA.description: Share of the window reserved for the newest turns, which are replayed word for word. Everything older is condensed. Raise it to keep more literal context, lower it to summarize sooner. Always leaves at least 500 characters for the summary.

CONVERSATION_SUMMARY_TARGET_WINDOW_CHARS.description: Total characters of conversational memory sent to the answering model: the verbatim recent turns plus the injected summary. Clamped to 10000–15000.

CONVERSATION_SUMMARY_TIERS.description: Number of recency tiers used for gradient compression: the oldest tier is condensed hardest, the tier next to the verbatim turns the least. 1–5.

DIGEST_BATCH_SIZE.description: Messages handed to the digest model per call during the daily indexing job. 5–100.

DIGEST_BLOCK_MAX_CHARS.description: Hard character cap for the whole "Older conversations" block injected into the system prompt (digest lines plus pulled excerpts).

DIGEST_ENABLED.description: Deep memory master switch. A daily job condenses each user's KEY messages (documents, decisions, important facts) into one-line digests indexed in the vector DB; a chat prompt months later can then find and quote the original message ("the office rent letter from May"). Controls both the daily indexing job and the retrieval during chat. When OFF, older conversations are only reachable through extracted memories.

DIGEST_MAX_BATCHES_PER_USER.description: Cost cap: maximum digest-model calls per user per daily run. Unprocessed history is picked up by the next run (the per-user cursor never loses its place).

DIGEST_MAX_PER_USER.description: Per-user cap on active digest entries (the deep-memory sibling of the 500-memory limit). On overflow the oldest entries are deactivated first. Minimum 100.

DIGEST_MIN_SCORE.description: Vector similarity floor (0.0–1.0) a digest must clear to be considered at all. Raise it to cut noise, lower it to increase recall. Tuned with app:digest:eval.

DIGEST_PULL_MIN_SCORE.description: Raw similarity (0.0–1.0) a hit must clear before its source message is pulled verbatim. Higher than the search floor: pulling costs prompt space.

DIGEST_PULL_TOP_N.description: How many of the best hits get their ORIGINAL message pulled verbatim into the prompt (so the model can quote amounts and dates, not just know the message exists). 0 disables pulling; the digest lines still appear.

DIGEST_QUIET_SECONDS.description: Messages younger than this many seconds are left for a later run — the rolling summary covers the live conversation; the digest is the long-term index and must not race a chat still in progress.

DIGEST_RECENCY_HALF_LIFE_DAYS.description: Half-life of the recency decay in days: at this age a digest's effective score is halved. Deliberately slow, so an old but highly relevant message still beats a recent vague one.

DIGEST_TOP_K.description: Maximum digest hits considered per chat turn (after re-ranking by similarity and recency). 1–20.

DROPBOX_APP_KEY.description: App key of the Dropbox app. Dropbox App Console (dropbox.com/developers/apps) → your app → Settings.

DROPBOX_APP_SECRET.description: App secret from the Dropbox App Console → your app → Settings → App secret (click "Show"). Stored encrypted and never shown again; leave the field untouched to keep the current one.

DROPBOX_ENABLED.description: Offer Dropbox as a connection. Requires an app key and app secret from a Dropbox app; the "Connect Dropbox" action stays hidden until all three are set.

DROPBOX_REDIRECT_URI.description: Only needed when a proxy changes the public URL. Leave empty to use APP_URL + /api/v1/connections/dropbox/callback. Whatever is used here must be registered in the Dropbox App Console character for character.

EMBEDDING_FALLBACK_PROVIDER.description: Provider to try when the primary embedding fails (e.g. "cloudflare"); empty disables fallback

FEATURE_AGENTS_ENABLED.description: AI assistants: the assistant builder (instructions, knowledge folders, tools, publish as chat widget) and the /api/v1/agents API. When off, every assistant route answers 404 and the builder is hidden.

FEATURE_AGENTS_ROUTABLE_ENABLED.description: Assistants in routing: let the message sorter pick an assistant that was marked "reachable from chat" as the answer for a matching request. Off keeps assistants reachable only by explicit selection.

FEATURE_BUNDLE_ENABLED.description: Export and import: move assistants, instructions and saved tasks between installs as a synaplan-bundle file (/api/v1/bundles). The instance scope is admin-only.

FEATURE_DESKTOP_AGENT_ENABLED.description: Synaplan Desktop, under Manage → Channels. A paired computer can chat in the app and pick up waiting tasks. When this is off, that page is hidden, pairing stops, the app cannot chat, and waiting tasks are not picked up until you turn it on. There is no installer yet — the app is built from the source repository.

FEATURE_DOCUMENT_TOOLS_ENABLED.description: Office document tools: let the assistant build and revise Word, Excel and PowerPoint files step by step (with revisions) instead of the one-shot generator. Editing files a user uploaded stays a separate, off-by-default setting.

FEATURE_IAM_DIRECTORY_SYNC_ENABLED.description: Directory groups: at sign-in, put users into groups from the company login (OIDC groups claim). Does nothing without OIDC. The claim path and display names live under Sharing → Directory groups.

FEATURE_IAM_GROUPS_ENABLED.description: Users & groups: show Users under Operate and let administrators create groups. Members see their groups under Account. Sharing and group policies need this to be on.

FEATURE_IAM_GROUP_POLICIES_ENABLED.description: Group policies: let administrators set default models, allowed models, feature flags and a rate-limit tier per group (Users → Policies). Locked global defaults cannot be overridden. Requires Users & groups.

FEATURE_IAM_SHARING_ENABLED.description: Sharing: let owners share a knowledge folder, chat, AI assistant, saved task or chat widget with a user, a group or everyone. Adds Share buttons and "Shared with me" filters. Requires Users & groups.

FEATURE_IAM_USER_SEARCH_ENABLED.description: User search in the share picker. Off: an owner can share with users in a group they share, and with a group. On: an owner can share with any account on the instance. Groups are always searchable. Adding a member under Users → Groups still searches every account.

FEATURE_MULTITASK_URL_FETCH_ENABLED.description: Watched pages: fetch a web address, keep one saved copy per address, and let a scheduled Saved Task compare it and mail the differences. Also powers "get this URL" in chat. When off, the Watched pages tab is hidden.

FEATURE_PLATFORM_LINKS_ENABLED.description: Linked platforms: let Nextcloud, ownCloud and similar partner platforms connect their users to this instance (Operate → Users → Platform instances, Account → Linked platforms). The Outlook add-in connect path stays available either way.

FEATURE_SEARCH_AI_ENABLED.description: AI help in the search palette (Ctrl/Cmd+K): for a question in plain words, the search model (the chat model of each person unless an admin pins one) picks the best matching result and says why. Each use is one short AI call and counts as one message. Off keeps keyword and meaning search.

FEATURE_TOOLS_APPROVALS_ENABLED.description: Approvals: ask before a tool that changes or deletes something runs — in chat and in unattended Saved Tasks, which pause under Approvals until you decide. Defaults per tool class live under Routing → Tool policies.

FEATURE_TOOLS_CUSTOM_HTTP_ENABLED.description: Custom tools: let users declare their own HTTP / OpenAPI tools under Connections and use them from chat and Saved Tasks.

FEATURE_TOOLS_REGISTRY_ENABLED.description: Tool registry: list every callable (MCP, custom HTTP, built-in) in one registry the assistant and Saved Tasks pick from. Off restores the previous per-loop catalogs — a kill switch, not a feature to leave off.

FEATURE_WORKFLOWS_BUILDER_ENABLED.description: Steps editor and webhook trigger for Saved Tasks: pin the exact steps a task runs, ask before a tool step, and start a task from an incoming webhook. When off, saved tasks keep Run now and the schedule only.

GOOGLE_GEMINI_API_KEY.description: Google Gemini API key — also unlocks Imagen, Nano Banana, Veo and Gemini TTS

GOOGLE_VERTEX_ACCESS_TOKEN.description: Optional OAuth bearer for Vertex AI Imagen; leave empty to use Gemini API (Imagen 4) with the key above

GUEST_CHAT_ENABLED.description: Let visitors try the chat without signing in. Turn this off so everyone has to sign in first — unauthenticated visitors are sent to the login page and every guest endpoint is refused.

HIGGSFIELD_API_KEY.description: Higgsfield API key — Soul/Reve images, DoP and Kling video. Both halves are required

HIGGSFIELD_API_SECRET.description: Higgsfield API secret — the key alone will not authenticate

HUGGINGFACE_API_KEY.description: HuggingFace API token — routes the Kimi models through HF Inference

IAM_ADMIN_IMPERSONATION.description: Whether administrators may view the application as another user. "audited" writes an audit row (default). "disabled" blocks the action.

IAM_AUDIT_RETENTION_DAYS.description: Days to keep Users audit rows. Default 365. 0 keeps them forever. Run app:iam:reap-audit on a schedule to apply this.

IAM_DIRECTORY_GROUPS_CLAIM.description: Dotted claim path for directory groups (default: groups). Same resolver as OIDC roles; comma-separated paths are allowed.

IAM_DIRECTORY_GROUP_NAMES.description: Optional JSON map of claim value to display name, e.g. {"sales":"Sales"}. Empty object keeps the claim value as the group name.

IAM_EVERYONE_SHARES.description: Who may share with everyone who has an account. On an instance where anyone can sign up, that is every registered account. "any_owner" lets every owner do it. "admins_only" lets only administrators create those shares; shares that already exist keep working. "disabled" removes that audience: new shares are refused, and shares people created earlier grant nothing until you pick another value — the people they reached lose access without being told. Nothing is deleted, so switching back restores those shares. System assistants and plugin-pack assistants stay available to every account on every value. A public instance should use "disabled"; an install that is one organization can use "any_owner".

IOS_APP_URL.description: App Store link shown on the forced-update screen (iOS).

M365_CLIENT_ID.description: Application (client) ID of the Azure app registration. Azure portal → App registrations → your app → Overview.

M365_CLIENT_SECRET.description: Client secret from Azure portal → your app → Certificates & secrets → New client secret. Copy the "Value" column, NOT the "Secret ID". Stored encrypted and never shown again; leave the field untouched to keep the current one.

M365_ENABLED.description: Offer Microsoft 365 as a connection. Requires a client ID and client secret from an Azure app registration; the "Connect Microsoft 365" action stays hidden until all three are set.

M365_REDIRECT_URI.description: Only needed when a proxy changes the public URL. Leave empty to use APP_URL + /api/v1/connections/m365/callback. Whatever is used here must be registered in Azure character for character.

M365_TENANT.description: Which accounts may sign in: "common" (work, school and personal accounts), "organizations" (work and school only), or a single tenant GUID to allow only your own organisation. Self-hosters normally use their own tenant GUID (Azure portal → your app → Overview → Directory (tenant) ID).

MARKETING_NEWS_ENABLED.description: Show marketing news on the guest landing. When enabled, anonymous visitors see a news card grid on the empty chat screen (fetched from the feed URLs below). When disabled, the landing shows only the welcome text and no feed is fetched. Off by default on every installation.

MARKETING_NEWS_FEED_URL_DE.description: RSS/WordPress feed URL for German-speaking visitors. Ignored while the master switch is off.

MARKETING_NEWS_FEED_URL_DEFAULT.description: Fallback RSS/WordPress feed URL for all other languages (e.g. ES, TR). Ignored while the master switch is off.

MARKETING_NEWS_FEED_URL_EN.description: RSS/WordPress feed URL for English-speaking visitors. Ignored while the master switch is off.

MAX_CHAT_MEMORIES.description: Max memories loaded into chat context

MCP_CLIENT_ENABLED.description: Allow the assistant to call connected MCP servers (Jira, Confluence, CRM, and any other MCP endpoint). When off, saved connections stay in place but no calls are made. You can also turn this on from Manage → Connections → MCP Servers.

MCP_OAUTH_CONNECTORS_ENABLED.description: Let users connect remote MCP servers that sign in with OAuth (Notion, Higgsfield, and any other standard remote MCP). When off, users can still add servers that use an access token. Seeded off — turn this on after you have reviewed the connections page.

MEDIA_ASYNC_JOBS_ENABLED.description: Run media generation (image, video, audio) as background jobs so the chat is never blocked — the assistant shows a live status banner and a completion toast. When OFF, renders run inline and the turn blocks until they finish. Requires the worker container. Global default; existing users keep their own setting until they opt in.

META_API_KEY.description: Meta Model API key — Muse Spark, Muse Wonder, Muse Image, and Muse Voice Transcribe. Create it at https://dev.meta.ai/ (API keys)

MIN_APP_VERSION.description: Minimum supported mobile app version (e.g. 4.0 or 4.1.2). Apps older than this are blocked with a "please update" screen. Leave empty to disable the gate.

MIN_CHAT_FEEDBACK_SCORE.description: Min score for feedback in chat context (0.0–1.0)

MIN_CHAT_MEMORY_SCORE.description: Min score for memories in chat context (0.0–1.0)

MIN_EXTRACTION_SCORE.description: Min score for memory extraction context (0.0–1.0)

MISTRAL_API_KEY.description: Mistral API key — chat, vision and the Voxtral audio pair

MULTITASK_ROUTING_ENABLED.description: Route messages through the multi-task planner (turns a request into a small DAG of capability tasks). When OFF, the legacy single-topic AI sorter handles routing. Global default for all users; an explicit per-user BCONFIG row still overrides it.

OIDC_ALLOW_USER_PROVISIONING.description: Create a Synaplan account on the first SSO sign-in. Turn off to admit only people who have signed in through SSO before; accounts created another way are not taken over. Restart required.

OIDC_BEARER_AUDIENCE.description: Audience the access token must carry. Leave empty to use the client ID. When set, it is also requested at sign-in, which Kinde and Auth0 need (Kinde: the audience of the API registered for the application). Restart required.

OIDC_ORG_CLAIM.description: Token claim that holds the organization (dot notation). org_code for Kinde, organization for Keycloak. Restart required.

OIDC_ORG_CODE.description: Only people from this organization may sign in. Sent to the provider at sign-in (Kinde org_code) and checked in the token. Leave empty for no organization check. Restart required.

OIDC_PERMISSIONS_CLAIM.description: Token claim that holds the permissions (dot notation). Restart required.

OIDC_PROVIDER_LABEL.description: Text on the sign-in button. Leave empty to show Enterprise SSO. Restart required.

OIDC_REQUIRED_PERMISSIONS.description: Comma-separated permissions; a person needs all of them to sign in. Leave empty for no permission check. Restart required.

OIDC_REQUIRED_ROLE.description: Comma-separated roles; a person needs at least one of them to sign in (case-insensitive). Roles are read from the role claims below. Leave empty for no role check. Restart required.

OIDC_ROLE_CLAIMS.description: Comma-separated token claims that hold roles (dot notation, {client_id} placeholder). Also decides who becomes administrator. Add roles for Kinde. Restart required.

OIDC_SCOPES.description: Space-separated permissions requested at sign-in. offline_access is rewritten to offline when the provider advertises offline and not offline_access (Kinde). A refused permission stops sign-in and names the permission. Restart required.

PROGRESS_SHOW_MODELS.description: Name the model and provider doing the work in the progress lines ("Sending your request to Claude Opus 4.8 by Anthropic…", "Creating your audio with tts-1 by OpenAI…"). Turn OFF for white-label deployments that must not reveal which vendors are used; the lines then read generically ("Sending your request…"). On by default.

PROGRESS_SHOW_STEPS.description: Show the step-by-step progress of an answer while it is being prepared: understanding the request, web search, pages read, request sent to the model, model thinking, memory check. Finished steps stay listed until the answer streams, then fold into a one-line summary that remains on the finished message. When OFF, only the current phase is shown (one line, no history). On by default.

PROGRESS_SHOW_TIMINGS.description: Show how long each finished step took and a live elapsed counter on the running step. When OFF, steps are listed without durations. On by default.

REGISTRATION_ENABLED.description: Allow visitors to create their own account with email and password. Turn this off for an invite-only instance (an administrator then creates every account) or for SSO-only deployments. The sign-up page and the API both refuse when off.

SAVEDTASKS_ENABLED.description: Allow users to pin a Task Prompt as a Saved Task and run it on demand or on a schedule. When OFF, AI Instructions stay unchanged and no Saved Task APIs or UI are exposed. Per-user BCONFIG row overrides the global row; code default is OFF when no row exists.

SIGNUP_PAUSED.description: Pause sign-up. Emergency switch for a flood of fake accounts: while on, no new account can be created on any path (email, Google, GitHub, Apple) and the person is told sign-up is paused. Existing accounts sign in as usual. Takes effect immediately, no restart.

TELEGRAM_ALLOW_LOCAL_WEBHOOK.description: Allow a local APP_URL for the Telegram webhook (development only)

TELEGRAM_ENABLED.description: Let people connect their own Telegram bot

TELEGRAM_WEBHOOK_BASE_URL.description: Public base URL Telegram calls. Empty uses APP_URL.

THEHIVE_API_KEY.description: TheHive API key — Flux Schnell and SDXL image generation

TOOLS_APPROVAL_EXPIRY_HOURS.description: Hours a pending approval waits before it expires (1–720). Default 72.

TOOLS_POLICY_DESTRUCTIVE.description: Default for tools that delete something: auto, approve or block.

TOOLS_POLICY_READ.description: Default for tools that only read data: auto, approve or block.

TOOLS_POLICY_WRITE.description: Default for tools that change something: auto, approve or block.

TRUSTEDTOKENS_API_KEY.description: TrustedTokens API key — sovereign inference on German GPUs (GLM, DeepSeek, Qwen, GPT OSS)

TURNSTILE_SITE_KEY.description: Cloudflare Turnstile site key. With both Turnstile keys set, Turnstile runs in front of sign-up, sign-in and every Google/GitHub/Apple start, and reCAPTCHA is ignored. Fails closed.

USAGE_TAXIMETER_ENABLED.description: Show the in-chat usage display: a consumption bar (desktop) / ring (mobile) with today's spend, a session statistics popover, and a token-cost badge on each AI reply. When OFF, none of these render and the app skips the extra daily-total queries. This does NOT affect the full Statistics page or the recorded usage data — it only toggles the in-chat display. On by default.

XAI_API_KEY.description: xAI (Grok) API key — chat, image understanding, Grok Imagine media, and Grok voice

A2AGENT_API_KEY.description: A2Agent API key — Qwen, DeepSeek and MiniMax via the A2Agent gateway (Chinese model vendors)

ANDROID_APP_URL.description: Play Store link shown on the forced-update screen (Android).

APPLE_CLIENT_ID.description: Apple Services ID (web OAuth client ID / id_token audience)

APPLE_KEY_ID.description: Key ID of the Sign-in-with-Apple private key (.p8)

APP_ADMIN_EMAIL.description: Operator inbox for incident + content-moderation alerts

BRAND_ACCENT_COLOR.description: Optional accent color as a hex value. Leave empty to keep the default palette.

BRAND_ACCENT_COLOR_DARK.description: Optional accent color used in DARK mode as a hex value. Leave empty to reuse the light accent color.

BRAND_DEFAULT_ROUTE.description: Post-login default: a route name (e.g. "chat") or a free-form path starting with "/" (e.g. "/files"). Leave empty to keep the default; unknown values fail safe to the default.

BRAND_FONT_FAMILY.description: Body font-family CSS stack (e.g. "Inter, sans-serif"). Leave empty to keep the default font.

BRAND_FONT_URL.description: Optional web-font stylesheet URL (self-hosted or provider). The origin must be on the CSP allow-list; for the app, on the configured server's allowed origins. Leave empty for no external font.

BRAND_HEADING_FONT_FAMILY.description: Optional heading font-family CSS stack. Leave empty to fall back to the body font/default.

BRAND_HOMEPAGE_URL.description: Brand homepage link used on auth and footer surfaces.

BRAND_ICON_URL.description: Brand icon URL (SVG recommended). Used for the sidebar mark, the favicon and the faint background watermark. Empty falls back to the light logo, then to the bundled Synaplan bird.

BRAND_LANDING_PAGE.description: Logged-out landing: a route name (e.g. "login") or a free-form path starting with "/" (e.g. "/welcome"). Must be a public page. Leave empty to keep the default; unknown/non-public values fail safe to the default.

BRAND_LOGO_DARK_URL.description: Dark-mode logo URL. Leave empty to use the bundled Synaplan logo.

BRAND_LOGO_URL.description: Light-mode logo URL. Leave empty to use the bundled Synaplan logo.

BRAND_NAME.description: Displayed brand/product name (document title, auth screens, attribution).

BRAND_POWERED_BY_LABEL.description: Attribution label — the platform being credited (e.g. "Synaplan").

BRAND_POWERED_BY_URL.description: Attribution link target for the "powered by" label.

BRAND_PRIMARY_COLOR.description: Primary accent color as a hex value (e.g. #003fc7). Injected into the --brand CSS variables at runtime.

BRAND_PRIMARY_COLOR_DARK.description: Primary accent color used in DARK mode as a hex value. Leave empty to auto-derive a dark-friendly tint from the light primary color.

BRAND_PRIVACY_URL.description: Privacy-policy link. Reachable in-app (Settings) and used in store metadata; store policy (Apple/Google) requires it. White-label brands point this at their own page.

BRAND_SECONDARY_COLOR.description: Optional secondary color as a hex value. Leave empty to keep the default palette.

BRAND_SECONDARY_COLOR_DARK.description: Optional secondary color used in DARK mode as a hex value. Leave empty to reuse the light secondary color.

BRAND_SHOW_POWERED_BY.description: Show the "· powered by <label>" attribution across auth, logged-out, shared-chat and widget surfaces.

BRAND_TAGLINE.description: Optional short tagline/description shown beside the brand.

BRAND_TERMS_URL.description: Terms-of-use link. Reachable in-app (Settings) and used in store metadata. White-label brands point this at their own page.

CEREBRAS_API_KEY.description: Cerebras Inference API key — GPT OSS 120B and Qwen 3.8 27B. Create it at https://cloud.cerebras.ai/ (API Keys)

CHAT_ARTIFACTS_ENABLED.description: Offer a sandboxed preview for HTML and SVG answers. Off when this row is missing and CHAT_ARTIFACTS_ENABLED is empty. An explicit on in either place turns the preview on. An explicit off in either place turns it off.

CHAT_EXPORT_ENABLED.description: Let people download a chat (Markdown, PDF, JSON) and include chats in account export. A group policy can turn this off for one group. On when this row is missing.

CHAT_SHARE_ENABLED.description: Let people create a public link for a chat. A group policy can turn this off for one group. On when this row is missing.

CHAT_WELCOME_SHOW_STORE_CARDS.description: Show the App Store, Google Play and GitHub cards on an empty chat. On when this row is missing, so existing installations stay as they are until you turn it off.

CHAT_WELCOME_SHOW_WIDGET_PROMO.description: Show the "embed a chat widget on your website" promotion above the composer. On when this row is missing.

CLOUDFLARE_ACCOUNT_ID.description: Cloudflare account ID for Workers AI embeddings (bge-m3)

CLOUDFLARE_API_TOKEN.description: Cloudflare API token with Workers AI access

COMPUTE_DEFAULT_CPU.description: Default CPU share for a file-work run.

COMPUTE_DEFAULT_MEMORY_MB.description: Default memory cap in megabytes for a file-work run.

COMPUTE_DEFAULT_OUTPUT_MB.description: Default size cap in megabytes for files the run may create.

COMPUTE_DEFAULT_PIDS.description: Default process cap for a file-work run.

COMPUTE_DEFAULT_TIMEOUT_SEC.description: Default seconds a file-work run may take.

COMPUTE_EGRESS_ENABLED.description: Let a file-work run fetch from a short list of public websites the assistant named. Off by default — runs stay offline. Private or local addresses are always refused. Can only be switched on when the connected compute sidecar offers website access (features.egress in its health report).

COMPUTE_EGRESS_MAX_HOSTS.description: How many websites one file-work run may list. Default 8.

COMPUTE_EGRESS_REQUIRES_APPROVAL.description: When a run will fetch from the web, ask the owner first even if everyday file work would run automatically. On by default.

COMPUTE_ENABLED.description: Let the assistant do short file work (Python or Node) on copies of files you chose. Needs the compute sidecar (COMPUTE_URL + COMPUTE_TOKEN). Local `docker compose up` starts that sidecar and turns this on.

COMPUTE_MAX_TIMEOUT_SEC.description: Hard ceiling in seconds for a file-work run.

COMPUTE_POLICY_INTERACTIVE.description: When the owner is present (chat or a live API call): run file work automatically, ask first, or never run it. An assistant cannot loosen this.

COMPUTE_POLICY_UNATTENDED.description: When a saved task runs file work on its own: ask the owner first (default), run automatically, or never run it. An assistant cannot loosen this.

COMPUTE_REQUIRE_TIER.description: Minimum isolation the compute sidecar must report before file work turns on: Standard (plain Docker), Strong isolation (gVisor), Virtual machine (microVM). Synaplan Cloud requires Strong isolation.

COMPUTE_WORKSPACES_ENABLED.description: Keep a folder between file-work runs so the assistant can continue yesterday's work. Off by default. Files → Workspace shows what is in it. Also needs file work itself to be on.

COMPUTE_WORKSPACE_TTL_DAYS.description: How many days a file-work folder may sit unused before cleanup can remove it. Default 90.

CONVERSATION_SUMMARY_CACHE_TTL.description: Seconds the stored summary is kept before Redis expires it. The summary is refreshed asynchronously after each long-chat turn, so a follow-up turn never waits on the summarizer. Raise this on quiet installs; lower it only if you need settings changes to take effect faster.

CONVERSATION_SUMMARY_ENABLED.description: Condense the earlier part of a long chat into a rolling summary that is injected into the system prompt, while the newest turns are still replayed word for word. Keeps the topic, the user's position and past decisions alive many answers later. The summary is written asynchronously after each turn by the Summary model (configurable under AI → Routing), so answering stays snappy. When OFF, a long chat only ever sees the most recent turns.

CONVERSATION_SUMMARY_MAX_CHARS.description: Hard cap on the injected summary itself. Capped at whatever the window has left after the verbatim turns.

CONVERSATION_SUMMARY_MAX_SOURCE_MESSAGES.description: Upper bound on how many older messages are fed to the Summary model in one call. Bounds the cost of summarizing a very long conversation; older messages beyond this are represented by the previous summary.

CONVERSATION_SUMMARY_RECENT_VERBATIM_CHA.description: Share of the window reserved for the newest turns, which are replayed word for word. Everything older is condensed. Raise it to keep more literal context, lower it to summarize sooner. Always leaves at least 500 characters for the summary.

CONVERSATION_SUMMARY_TARGET_WINDOW_CHARS.description: Total characters of conversational memory sent to the answering model: the verbatim recent turns plus the injected summary. Clamped to 10000–15000.

CONVERSATION_SUMMARY_TIERS.description: Number of recency tiers used for gradient compression: the oldest tier is condensed hardest, the tier next to the verbatim turns the least. 1–5.

DIGEST_BATCH_SIZE.description: Messages handed to the digest model per call during the daily indexing job. 5–100.

DIGEST_BLOCK_MAX_CHARS.description: Hard character cap for the whole "Older conversations" block injected into the system prompt (digest lines plus pulled excerpts).

DIGEST_ENABLED.description: Deep memory master switch. A daily job condenses each user's KEY messages (documents, decisions, important facts) into one-line digests indexed in the vector DB; a chat prompt months later can then find and quote the original message ("the office rent letter from May"). Controls both the daily indexing job and the retrieval during chat. When OFF, older conversations are only reachable through extracted memories.

DIGEST_MAX_BATCHES_PER_USER.description: Cost cap: maximum digest-model calls per user per daily run. Unprocessed history is picked up by the next run (the per-user cursor never loses its place).

DIGEST_MAX_PER_USER.description: Per-user cap on active digest entries (the deep-memory sibling of the 500-memory limit). On overflow the oldest entries are deactivated first. Minimum 100.

DIGEST_MIN_SCORE.description: Vector similarity floor (0.0–1.0) a digest must clear to be considered at all. Raise it to cut noise, lower it to increase recall. Tuned with app:digest:eval.

DIGEST_PULL_MIN_SCORE.description: Raw similarity (0.0–1.0) a hit must clear before its source message is pulled verbatim. Higher than the search floor: pulling costs prompt space.

DIGEST_PULL_TOP_N.description: How many of the best hits get their ORIGINAL message pulled verbatim into the prompt (so the model can quote amounts and dates, not just know the message exists). 0 disables pulling; the digest lines still appear.

DIGEST_QUIET_SECONDS.description: Messages younger than this many seconds are left for a later run — the rolling summary covers the live conversation; the digest is the long-term index and must not race a chat still in progress.

DIGEST_RECENCY_HALF_LIFE_DAYS.description: Half-life of the recency decay in days: at this age a digest's effective score is halved. Deliberately slow, so an old but highly relevant message still beats a recent vague one.

DIGEST_TOP_K.description: Maximum digest hits considered per chat turn (after re-ranking by similarity and recency). 1–20.

DROPBOX_APP_KEY.description: App key of the Dropbox app. Dropbox App Console (dropbox.com/developers/apps) → your app → Settings.

DROPBOX_APP_SECRET.description: App secret from the Dropbox App Console → your app → Settings → App secret (click "Show"). Stored encrypted and never shown again; leave the field untouched to keep the current one.

DROPBOX_ENABLED.description: Offer Dropbox as a connection. Requires an app key and app secret from a Dropbox app; the "Connect Dropbox" action stays hidden until all three are set.

DROPBOX_REDIRECT_URI.description: Only needed when a proxy changes the public URL. Leave empty to use APP_URL + /api/v1/connections/dropbox/callback. Whatever is used here must be registered in the Dropbox App Console character for character.

EMBEDDING_FALLBACK_PROVIDER.description: Provider to try when the primary embedding fails (e.g. "cloudflare"); empty disables fallback

FEATURE_AGENTS_ENABLED.description: AI assistants: the assistant builder (instructions, knowledge folders, tools, publish as chat widget) and the /api/v1/agents API. When off, every assistant route answers 404 and the builder is hidden.

FEATURE_AGENTS_ROUTABLE_ENABLED.description: Assistants in routing: let the message sorter pick an assistant that was marked "reachable from chat" as the answer for a matching request. Off keeps assistants reachable only by explicit selection.

FEATURE_BUNDLE_ENABLED.description: Export and import: move assistants, instructions and saved tasks between installs as a synaplan-bundle file (/api/v1/bundles). The instance scope is admin-only.

FEATURE_DESKTOP_AGENT_ENABLED.description: Synaplan Desktop, under Manage → Channels. A paired computer can chat in the app and pick up waiting tasks. When this is off, that page is hidden, pairing stops, the app cannot chat, and waiting tasks are not picked up until you turn it on. There is no installer yet — the app is built from the source repository.

FEATURE_DOCUMENT_TOOLS_ENABLED.description: Office document tools: let the assistant build and revise Word, Excel and PowerPoint files step by step (with revisions) instead of the one-shot generator. Editing files a user uploaded stays a separate, off-by-default setting.

FEATURE_IAM_DIRECTORY_SYNC_ENABLED.description: Directory groups: at sign-in, put users into groups from the company login (OIDC groups claim). Does nothing without OIDC. The claim path and display names live under Sharing → Directory groups.

FEATURE_IAM_GROUPS_ENABLED.description: Users & groups: show Users under Operate and let administrators create groups. Members see their groups under Account. Sharing and group policies need this to be on.

FEATURE_IAM_GROUP_POLICIES_ENABLED.description: Group policies: let administrators set default models, allowed models, feature flags and a rate-limit tier per group (Users → Policies). Locked global defaults cannot be overridden. Requires Users & groups.

FEATURE_IAM_SHARING_ENABLED.description: Sharing: let owners share a knowledge folder, chat, AI assistant, saved task or chat widget with a user, a group or everyone. Adds Share buttons and "Shared with me" filters. Requires Users & groups.

FEATURE_IAM_USER_SEARCH_ENABLED.description: User search in the share picker. Off: an owner can share with users in a group they share, and with a group. On: an owner can share with any account on the instance. Groups are always searchable. Adding a member under Users → Groups still searches every account.

FEATURE_MODULES_GATE_CHAT_ARTIFACTS.description: Hide the "chat_artifacts" module while it is not configured: its API routes answer 404 and the interface shows no card for it. On is the shipped default for new installs. Configure the module first — see Operate → System status.

FEATURE_MODULES_GATE_THEHIVE.description: Hide the "thehive" module while it is not configured: its API routes answer 404 and the interface shows no card for it. On is the shipped default for new installs. Configure the module first — see Operate → System status.

FEATURE_MODULES_GATE_TIKA.description: Hide the "tika" module while it is not configured: its API routes answer 404 and the interface shows no card for it. On is the shipped default for new installs. Configure the module first — see Operate → System status.

FEATURE_MODULES_GATE_WHATSAPP.description: Hide the "whatsapp" module while it is not configured: its API routes answer 404 and the interface shows no card for it. On is the shipped default for new installs. Configure the module first — see Operate → System status.

FEATURE_MULTITASK_URL_FETCH_ENABLED.description: Watched pages: fetch a web address, keep one saved copy per address, and let a scheduled Saved Task compare it and mail the differences. Also powers "get this URL" in chat. When off, the Watched pages tab is hidden.

FEATURE_PLATFORM_LINKS_ENABLED.description: Linked platforms: let Nextcloud, ownCloud and similar partner platforms connect their users to this instance (Operate → Users → Platform instances, Account → Linked platforms). The Outlook add-in connect path stays available either way.

FEATURE_SEARCH_AI_ENABLED.description: AI help in the search palette (Ctrl/Cmd+K): for a question in plain words, the search model (the chat model of each person unless an admin pins one) picks the best matching result and says why. Each use is one short AI call and counts as one message. Off keeps keyword and meaning search.

FEATURE_TOOLS_APPROVALS_ENABLED.description: Approvals: ask before a tool that changes or deletes something runs — in chat and in unattended Saved Tasks, which pause under Approvals until you decide. Defaults per tool class live under Routing → Tool policies.

FEATURE_TOOLS_CUSTOM_HTTP_ENABLED.description: Custom tools: let users declare their own HTTP / OpenAPI tools under Connections and use them from chat and Saved Tasks.

FEATURE_TOOLS_REGISTRY_ENABLED.description: Tool registry: list every callable (MCP, custom HTTP, built-in) in one registry the assistant and Saved Tasks pick from. Off restores the previous per-loop catalogs — a kill switch, not a feature to leave off.

FEATURE_WORKFLOWS_BUILDER_ENABLED.description: Steps editor and webhook trigger for Saved Tasks: pin the exact steps a task runs, ask before a tool step, and start a task from an incoming webhook. When off, saved tasks keep Run now and the schedule only.

GOOGLE_GEMINI_API_KEY.description: Google Gemini API key — also unlocks Imagen, Nano Banana, Veo and Gemini TTS

GOOGLE_VERTEX_ACCESS_TOKEN.description: Optional OAuth bearer for Vertex AI Imagen; leave empty to use Gemini API (Imagen 4) with the key above

GUEST_CHAT_ENABLED.description: Let visitors try the chat without signing in. Turn this off so everyone has to sign in first — unauthenticated visitors are sent to the login page and every guest endpoint is refused.

HIGGSFIELD_API_KEY.description: Higgsfield API key — Soul/Reve images, DoP and Kling video. Both halves are required

HIGGSFIELD_API_SECRET.description: Higgsfield API secret — the key alone will not authenticate

HUGGINGFACE_API_KEY.description: HuggingFace API token — routes the Kimi models through HF Inference

IAM_ADMIN_IMPERSONATION.description: Whether administrators may view the application as another user. "audited" writes an audit row (default). "disabled" blocks the action.

IAM_AUDIT_RETENTION_DAYS.description: Days to keep Users audit rows. Default 365. 0 keeps them forever. Run app:iam:reap-audit on a schedule to apply this.

IAM_DIRECTORY_GROUPS_CLAIM.description: Dotted claim path for directory groups (default: groups). Same resolver as OIDC roles; comma-separated paths are allowed.

IAM_DIRECTORY_GROUP_NAMES.description: Optional JSON map of claim value to display name, e.g. {"sales":"Sales"}. Empty object keeps the claim value as the group name.

IAM_EVERYONE_SHARES.description: Who may share with everyone who has an account. On an instance where anyone can sign up, that is every registered account. "any_owner" lets every owner do it. "admins_only" lets only administrators create those shares; shares that already exist keep working. "disabled" removes that audience: new shares are refused, and shares people created earlier grant nothing until you pick another value — the people they reached lose access without being told. Nothing is deleted, so switching back restores those shares. System assistants and plugin-pack assistants stay available to every account on every value. A public instance should use "disabled"; an install that is one organization can use "any_owner".

IOS_APP_URL.description: App Store link shown on the forced-update screen (iOS).

M365_CLIENT_ID.description: Application (client) ID of the Azure app registration. Azure portal → App registrations → your app → Overview.

M365_CLIENT_SECRET.description: Client secret from Azure portal → your app → Certificates & secrets → New client secret. Copy the "Value" column, NOT the "Secret ID". Stored encrypted and never shown again; leave the field untouched to keep the current one.

M365_ENABLED.description: Offer Microsoft 365 as a connection. Requires a client ID and client secret from an Azure app registration; the "Connect Microsoft 365" action stays hidden until all three are set.

M365_REDIRECT_URI.description: Only needed when a proxy changes the public URL. Leave empty to use APP_URL + /api/v1/connections/m365/callback. Whatever is used here must be registered in Azure character for character.

M365_TENANT.description: Which accounts may sign in: "common" (work, school and personal accounts), "organizations" (work and school only), or a single tenant GUID to allow only your own organisation. Self-hosters normally use their own tenant GUID (Azure portal → your app → Overview → Directory (tenant) ID).

MARKETING_NEWS_ENABLED.description: Show marketing news on the guest landing. When enabled, anonymous visitors see a news card grid on the empty chat screen (fetched from the feed URLs below). When disabled, the landing shows only the welcome text and no feed is fetched. Off by default on every installation.

MARKETING_NEWS_FEED_URL_DE.description: RSS/WordPress feed URL for German-speaking visitors. Ignored while the master switch is off.

MARKETING_NEWS_FEED_URL_DEFAULT.description: Fallback RSS/WordPress feed URL for all other languages (e.g. ES, TR). Ignored while the master switch is off.

MARKETING_NEWS_FEED_URL_EN.description: RSS/WordPress feed URL for English-speaking visitors. Ignored while the master switch is off.

MAX_CHAT_MEMORIES.description: Max memories loaded into chat context

MCP_CLIENT_ENABLED.description: Allow the assistant to call connected MCP servers (Jira, Confluence, CRM, and any other MCP endpoint). When off, saved connections stay in place but no calls are made. You can also turn this on from Manage → Connections → MCP Servers.

MCP_OAUTH_CONNECTORS_ENABLED.description: Let users connect remote MCP servers that sign in with OAuth (Notion, Higgsfield, and any other standard remote MCP). When off, users can still add servers that use an access token. Seeded off — turn this on after you have reviewed the connections page.

MEDIA_ASYNC_JOBS_ENABLED.description: Run media generation (image, video, audio) as background jobs so the chat is never blocked — the assistant shows a live status banner and a completion toast. When OFF, renders run inline and the turn blocks until they finish. Requires the worker container. Global default; existing users keep their own setting until they opt in.

META_API_KEY.description: Meta Model API key — Muse Spark, Muse Wonder, Muse Image, and Muse Voice Transcribe. Create it at https://dev.meta.ai/ (API keys)

MIN_APP_VERSION.description: Minimum supported mobile app version (e.g. 4.0 or 4.1.2). Apps older than this are blocked with a "please update" screen. Leave empty to disable the gate.

MIN_CHAT_FEEDBACK_SCORE.description: Min score for feedback in chat context (0.0–1.0)

MIN_CHAT_MEMORY_SCORE.description: Min score for memories in chat context (0.0–1.0)

MIN_EXTRACTION_SCORE.description: Min score for memory extraction context (0.0–1.0)

MISTRAL_API_KEY.description: Mistral API key — chat, vision and the Voxtral audio pair

MULTITASK_ROUTING_ENABLED.description: Route messages through the multi-task planner (turns a request into a small DAG of capability tasks). When OFF, the legacy single-topic AI sorter handles routing. Global default for all users; an explicit per-user BCONFIG row still overrides it.

OIDC_ALLOW_USER_PROVISIONING.description: Create a Synaplan account on the first SSO sign-in. Turn off to admit only people who have signed in through SSO before; accounts created another way are not taken over. Restart required.

OIDC_BEARER_AUDIENCE.description: Audience the access token must carry. Leave empty to use the client ID. When set, it is also requested at sign-in, which Kinde and Auth0 need (Kinde: the audience of the API registered for the application). Restart required.

OIDC_ORG_CLAIM.description: Token claim that holds the organization (dot notation). org_code for Kinde, organization for Keycloak. Restart required.

OIDC_ORG_CODE.description: Only people from this organization may sign in. Sent to the provider at sign-in (Kinde org_code) and checked in the token. Leave empty for no organization check. Restart required.

OIDC_PERMISSIONS_CLAIM.description: Token claim that holds the permissions (dot notation). Restart required.

OIDC_PROVIDER_LABEL.description: Text on the sign-in button. Leave empty to show Enterprise SSO. Restart required.

OIDC_REQUIRED_PERMISSIONS.description: Comma-separated permissions; a person needs all of them to sign in. Leave empty for no permission check. Restart required.

OIDC_REQUIRED_ROLE.description: Comma-separated roles; a person needs at least one of them to sign in (case-insensitive). Roles are read from the role claims below. Leave empty for no role check. Restart required.

OIDC_ROLE_CLAIMS.description: Comma-separated token claims that hold roles (dot notation, {client_id} placeholder). Also decides who becomes administrator. Add roles for Kinde. Restart required.

OIDC_SCOPES.description: Space-separated permissions requested at sign-in. offline_access is rewritten to offline when the provider advertises offline and not offline_access (Kinde). A refused permission stops sign-in and names the permission. Restart required.

PROGRESS_SHOW_MODELS.description: Name the model and provider doing the work in the progress lines ("Sending your request to Claude Opus 4.8 by Anthropic…", "Creating your audio with tts-1 by OpenAI…"). Turn OFF for white-label deployments that must not reveal which vendors are used; the lines then read generically ("Sending your request…"). On by default.

PROGRESS_SHOW_STEPS.description: Show the step-by-step progress of an answer while it is being prepared: understanding the request, web search, pages read, request sent to the model, model thinking, memory check. Finished steps stay listed until the answer streams, then fold into a one-line summary that remains on the finished message. When OFF, only the current phase is shown (one line, no history). On by default.

PROGRESS_SHOW_TIMINGS.description: Show how long each finished step took and a live elapsed counter on the running step. When OFF, steps are listed without durations. On by default.

REGISTRATION_ENABLED.description: Allow visitors to create their own account with email and password. Turn this off for an invite-only instance (an administrator then creates every account) or for SSO-only deployments. The sign-up page and the API both refuse when off.

SAVEDTASKS_ENABLED.description: Allow users to pin a Task Prompt as a Saved Task and run it on demand or on a schedule. When OFF, AI Instructions stay unchanged and no Saved Task APIs or UI are exposed. Per-user BCONFIG row overrides the global row; code default is OFF when no row exists.

SIGNUP_PAUSED.description: Pause sign-up. Emergency switch for a flood of fake accounts: while on, no new account can be created on any path (email, Google, GitHub, Apple) and the person is told sign-up is paused. Existing accounts sign in as usual. Takes effect immediately, no restart.

TELEGRAM_ALLOW_LOCAL_WEBHOOK.description: Allow a local APP_URL for the Telegram webhook (development only)

TELEGRAM_ENABLED.description: Let people connect their own Telegram bot

TELEGRAM_WEBHOOK_BASE_URL.description: Public base URL Telegram calls. Empty uses APP_URL.

THEHIVE_API_KEY.description: TheHive API key — Flux Schnell and SDXL image generation

TOOLS_APPROVAL_EXPIRY_HOURS.description: Hours a pending approval waits before it expires (1–720). Default 72.

TOOLS_POLICY_DESTRUCTIVE.description: Default for tools that delete something: auto, approve or block.

TOOLS_POLICY_READ.description: Default for tools that only read data: auto, approve or block.

TOOLS_POLICY_WRITE.description: Default for tools that change something: auto, approve or block.

TRUSTEDTOKENS_API_KEY.description: TrustedTokens API key — sovereign inference on German GPUs (GLM, DeepSeek, Qwen, GPT OSS)

TURNSTILE_SITE_KEY.description: Cloudflare Turnstile site key. With both Turnstile keys set, Turnstile runs in front of sign-up, sign-in and every Google/GitHub/Apple start, and reCAPTCHA is ignored. Fails closed.

USAGE_TAXIMETER_ENABLED.description: Show the in-chat usage display: a consumption bar (desktop) / ring (mobile) with today's spend, a session statistics popover, and a token-cost badge on each AI reply. When OFF, none of these render and the app skips the extra daily-total queries. This does NOT affect the full Statistics page or the recorded usage data — it only toggles the in-chat display. On by default.

XAI_API_KEY.description: xAI (Grok) API key — chat, image understanding, Grok Imagine media, and Grok voice

sections.label: Optional modules — hide what is not configured

IAM_EVERYONE_SHARES.description: Who may share with everyone who has an account. On an instance where anyone can sign up, that is every registered account. "any_owner" lets every owner do it. "admins_only" lets only administrators create those shares; shares that already exist keep working. "disabled" removes that audience: new shares are refused, and shares people created earlier grant nothing until you pick another value — the people they reached lose access without being told. Nothing is deleted, so switching back restores those shares. System assistants and plugin-pack assistants stay available to every account on every value. A public instance should use "disabled"; an install that is one organization can use "any_owner".
